entities.name: UniProt Q8RX37
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana probable protein phosphatase 2C 2 (PP2C2); annotated EC 3.1.3.16.
Catalytic reaction: O-phospho-L-seryl- or O-phospho-L-threonyl-[protein] + H2O → protein-bound L-seryl/L-threonyl residue + phosphate.
Annotated cofactors are Mg2+ or Mn2+, with two divalent ions per subunit.

entities.name: Protein phosphatase 2C activity (EC 3.1.3.16)
observations: Hydrolyzes protein O-phosphoserine and O-phosphothreonine bonds, yielding the dephosphorylated protein residue and inorganic phosphate; represented by Rhea RHEA:20629 and RHEA:47004.
